pages.text: People are talking about you in my tavern. Mostly good things! Let me tell you about two more things that keep score.

&6Collections&r count everything you gather. Mine enough stone, chop enough logs, and you reach tiers: each pays XP and coins, and some unlock recipes at the bench. The Collections page in the K menu shows them all.
Your &6SkyRPG Level&r sums up everything: quests, collections, skill levels, boss kills. It's on your Profile page, and it shows next to your name in chat. Reach &6Stone tier I&r and &6level 2&r.
